reference.observation: Ambient typography and explicit host direction align Native ConfigProvider. Table-context case mounts a hidden public Source Table to load its expanded-row styles, then uses a native wrapper/table/tr with explicit width:100%/border-spacing:0 with the actual provider Table classes and public theme.useToken().hashId to isolate the two Descriptions expanded-row CSS rules from the separate Table prefix migration. Semantic callbacks retain raw local prefix. table-local/table-canonical result records the Source Table integration selector ignoring local Descriptions prefix; expectedNative is a derived expectation changing only view.display and table.flex to the measured global Table case. Native preserves expanded-row styling with local Descriptions, and scopes those selectors by its owner namespace. This correction does not claim full Table prefix support.
